Nodoka and Ayane climb off the stage together and make their way over to me. Probably to suck me off since the main competition is now over.

lines.en: : I see we’re not even heading back to the hotel room first. Okay. If that’s how things are now, I guess that’s just how things are.
lines.zh: : 看来我们是连酒店房间都不打算先回一趟了。行吧。如果事到如今就是这样了，那我想也只能这样了。

lines.en: : I don’t {i}specifically{/i} know what you’re thinking. I just know that you’re wrong.
lines.zh: : 我{i}具体{/i}不知道你在想什么。我只知道你想错了。

lines.en: : Did you enjoy the show? I tried to give you as many angles to see up my dress as possible. It seemed your mind was mostly elsewhere, though.
lines.zh: : 你喜欢刚才的演出吗？我尽量多给你留了些角度，好让你能往我裙子里看。不过看起来你的心思大多在别处。

lines.en: : My mind is pretty much always elsewhere, but I can promise you I tried to see up your dress as much as I could within that short window of time.
lines.zh: : 我的心思基本上永远在别处，但我可以向你保证，在那短短一段时间里，我已经尽我所能地往你裙子里看了。

lines.en: : How about me?
lines.zh: : 那我呢？

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo2
: Yours was easier to look up, so I didn’t have to try as hard. Thank you for taking the person I really am into consideration.
lines.zh: : 你的比较容易看进去，所以我不用那么费劲。谢谢你考虑到了我真正的为人。

lines.en: : Anything for my future husband, of course.
lines.zh: : 为了我未来的丈夫，当然什么都愿意。

lines.zh: : 我同意了……嗯。

lines.en: : Well...{i}no.{/i} But, after carefully weighing my options, I have decided that if there’s going to be a series of sexual contests involving you, I should probably be present.

lines.en: : It’s...far better than knowing what everyone else is doing while I sit in a hotel room all by myself at least.

lines.en: : Nodoka...what’s your goal this time? What have you done?
lines.zh: : Nodoka……这次你的目的是什么？你都做了什么？

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo5
: Cracked the code, of course. And I’ve managed to do so in a way that places you right back in the center of the universe where you belong.
lines.zh: : 当然是破解了密码。而且我还做到了把你重新放回宇宙的中心——你本该在的位置。

lines.en: : Surely {i}this{/i} year’s marathon of lust will bring me closer to my dream. And perhaps Ayane will be a step closer to hers as well if you finish inside of her?
lines.zh: : 今年的{i}这{/i}场欲望马拉松一定会让我离梦想更近。而如果你射在她里面的话，Ayane 大概也能离她的梦想更近一步吧？

lines.en: : And how many others did you rope into this again?

lines.en: : Five more. Three representatives from each floor. And all {i}you{/i} must do is lie there and provide fluids. So essentially, it’ll be just another night by your standards.
lines.zh: : 还有五个。每层楼三个代表。而你要做的只是躺在那里提供液体。所以按你的标准{i}来{/i}看，基本上也就是又一个普通的夜晚。

lines.en: : Why? You’d be doing the same thing {i}without{/i} my assistance. Does having me involved truly sour the taste of it all?
lines.zh: : 为什么？就算{i}没有{/i}我帮忙，你也会做同样的事。有我参与，真的就让这一切变味了吗？

lines.en: : If there’s blackmail involved, yes.
lines.zh: : 如果里面涉及威胁的话，是的。

lines.en: : There’s nothing of the sort. I merely handpicked those who I knew wouldn’t refuse. You should be {i}thanking{/i} me. You {i}did{/i} agree after all.
lines.zh: : 根本没有那种事。我只是精心挑了些我知道不会拒绝的人。你该{i}谢{/i}我才对。毕竟你答应过了。

lines.en: : Yeah. {i}Before{/i} I knew Ayane would have to take part in it. I don’t want to do that to her.
lines.zh: : 是啊。那是在我知道 Ayane 也得参与{i}之前{/i}。我不想这么对她。

lines.en: : Ayane, we don’t have to do this. We can go back to the hotel and hang out on our own tonight.
lines.zh: : Ayane，我们不必这样。我们可以回酒店，今晚就我们两个人待着。

lines.en: : And leave the others a sopping wet mess? We both know you don’t have the restraint to avoid such a thing.
lines.zh: : 然后让其他人湿得一塌糊涂地晾在那儿？我们俩都清楚，你可没有那份自制力不去干那种事。

lines.en: : It’s fine, Sensei...

lines.en: : As long as I can focus on you...I can make it work.

lines.en: : On that note — why don’t you head over to the staging area now, Ayane? I’ll be in contact with the others shortly.
lines.zh: : 既然如此——Ayane，你不如现在就去准备区？我稍后会跟其他人联系。

lines.en: : Guess I’ll just...find out who they are when we all awkwardly show up at the same time then.

lines.zh: : 不……不管怎样都会尴尬的。但我现在就走。

lines.en: : I take confidentiality quite seriously, you know. And I refined my selection process to only include those who I know would keep this under wraps.

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo8

lines.en: : I’m surprised you agreed to begin with. You’re not the type to allow yourself to get roped into Nodoka’s games.

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo13

lines.en: : Yeah, for now. Until you coerce five other girls who are going to be upset by this into an orgy.

lines.en: : No one {i}wants{/i} to share you, Akira. Even I would like to tie you up and keep you in my room where no one else can find you. Ayane is stronger than you give her credit for.
lines.zh: : 没有人{i}愿意{/i}分享你，Akira。就连我也想把你绑起来藏在房间里，让别人都找不到你。Ayane 比你以为的要坚强。

lines.zh: : 我……知道。但她扛得过来，不代表我就想再往她身上加更多的痛苦。而且如果其他人到最后也都是这样——

lines.en: : No two people are the same. Allow me to put your mind at ease though in stating that Ayane was the one I was most hesitant about inviting.
lines.zh: : 没有两个人是相同的。不过让我说一句让你放心的话：Ayane 是我邀请时最犹豫的一个。

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo17

lines.en: : Ayane is different, though. There’s something curious about you two that I have a hard time pinpointing. But it seems my gut was right once more.
lines.zh: : 但 Ayane 不一样。你们两个之间有种我说不清的古怪之处。不过看来我的直觉又一次对了。

lines.en: : I just don’t want anyone being hurt by this.

lines.en: : I imagine that the easiest way to hurt them {i}now{/i} would be to not show up at all. This contest is not as...spontaneous as the last. There was more planning this time.

lines.en: : Well, I wasn’t {i}here{/i} last time, so I don’t know what sort of weird sexual scenario you forced everyone into back then.

lines.en: : I imagine you’d have loved it if you {i}were{/i} there. But unfortunately, you needed room to...{i}breathe{/i} for some reason.

lines.en: : And I find life more interesting when one struggles to do that. Do you understand what I’m saying...Akira?

lines.en: : That said, though — you are at the center of a lot of suffering. And you very seldom make anyone feel {i}good,{/i} Nodoka.

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo20
: You know I don’t have the balls to actually stop you. And you know you’re so much smarter than me that you could prevent me from doing that even if I {i}wanted{/i} to.
lines.zh: : 你知道我根本没那个胆子真的去阻止你。你也知道你比我聪明太多，就算我{i}想{/i}阻止，你也能拦得住我。

lines.en: : So why do you always have to make shit so mysterious? Because if you’re not doing it to hurt anyone, keeping your mouth shut makes it {i}feel{/i} like you are.
lines.zh: : 那你为什么非要把事情搞得这么神秘？因为如果你并不是为了伤害谁，那你把嘴闭得这么紧，反而让人{i}觉得{/i}你就是。

lines.en: : Well?
lines.zh: : 怎么样？

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo21
: I can’t...
lines.zh: : 我做不到……

lines.en: : You’d call me crazy.
lines.zh: : 你会说我是疯子。

lines.en: : Nodoka...
lines.zh: : Nodoka……

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo22
: {i}Ahem.{/i}
: We mustn’t keep the others waiting. There’s a strict schedule we must abide by tonight for everything to go as planned. And...
lines.zh: : 我们不能让其他人等着。今晚有一张严格的时间表，一切要按计划进行。而且……

lines.en: : I apologize...
lines.zh: : 我很抱歉……

lines.en: : If that plan does not...make sense to you.
lines.zh: : 如果那个计划……对你来说讲不通的话。

lines.en: scene black
: But I can give you my word...
lines.zh: : 但我可以向你保证……

lines.en: : This is the way things must be if we are to ever pry the boards off of the windows that block out the light.
lines.zh: : 如果我们想要撬开那些挡住光线的窗板，事情就必须这样。

lines.en: : Come, Akira...
lines.zh: : 来吧，Akira……

lines.en: : Let us see the outside together.
lines.zh: : 让我们一起去看看外面。

lines.en: {i}One hour later...in yet another nondescript building...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}一小时后……在又一栋毫不起眼的建筑里……{/i}

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo23
: I come here today with a single question in mind. Is God truly real?
lines.zh: : 今天我来到这里，心里只带着一个问题。神真的存在吗？

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo24
: I refer specifically to the {i}traditional{/i} idea of God, of course. One entity above the others — {i}not{/i} to be confused with those who walk among us.
lines.zh: : 当然，我特指{i}传统{/i}意义上的神。一个高于其他存在的个体——{i}别{/i}和那些行走在我们之间的存在混为一谈。

lines.en: : Humans with the {i}powers{/i} of gods. Who have been gifted to us by something somewhere — hosts of the divine right who feed off of our worship to provide hope.
lines.zh: : 拥有神之{i}力量{/i}的凡人。是某个地方的什么东西赐给我们的——承载神权的宿主，靠我们的崇拜为食，以此供给希望。

lines.en: : We, these perverse and perverted amalgamations of flesh and blood, have {i}not{/i} the power these god-kings possess!
lines.zh: : 而我们，这些血肉拼凑出的变态集合体，根本{i}不{/i}具备那些神王所拥有的力量！

lines.en: : So what purpose do we serve but to {i}serve{/i} the all-powerful ourselves?
lines.zh: : 那么除了{i}侍奉{/i}那位全能者，我们还有什么存在的意义？

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo25
: Today, we offer ourselves up as sacrifices! Our bodies — meat for the carnivorous, primal desires of Akira Arakawa, the god-king of Kumon-mi!
lines.zh: : 今天，我们把自己献祭出去！我们的身体——是喂给 Kumon-mi 的神王、Akira Arakawa 那食肉的、原始的欲望的肉！

lines.en: : {i}Today,{/i} we revel in our idolatry and subject ourselves to a series of trials and rituals meant to fill the holes in him while {i}he{/i} fills the holes in us!
lines.zh: : {i}今天{/i}，我们沉醉于自己的偶像崇拜，让自己接受一连串的试炼与仪式——用我们来填他身上的洞，同时也让{i}他{/i}来填我们身上的洞！

lines.en: : God-king! Please taste us as if we’ve been cut open. And love us in the ways only a good king can love his subjects.
lines.zh: : 神王啊！请品尝我们吧，就像我们被剖开了一样。并用只有一位好王才能爱他子民的方式来爱我们。

lines.en: : Our hearts are the strings that anchor you to the ground and prevent your ascension. Sever them all and you may taste the nectar that drips from the tongue of the eternal sky!
lines.zh: : 我们的心是把你拴在地上、阻止你飞升的绳索。把它们全部斩断，你便能尝到从永恒天空的舌尖滴落的花蜜！

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo26
: So I guess you’re some sort of fanatic now too, huh?
lines.zh: : 所以你现在也算是个狂信徒了，是吧？

lines.en: : For the next several hours, yes.
lines.zh: : 接下来的几个小时里，是的。

lines.en: : I thought a centralized theme might be fun and figured you would appreciate being openly worshiped instead of all our kneeling taking place at our bedsides.
lines.zh: : 我觉得有个统一的主题会比较有趣，而且想你大概会喜欢被公开崇拜，而不是让我们每次都跪在床边。

lines.en: : Were all of the signs really necessary, though?
lines.zh: : 不过，那些牌子真的都有必要吗？

lines.en: : Probably not. But I had a coupon that was going to expire. Surely you don’t mind. May I proceed now, King Akira?
lines.zh: : 大概没有。但我手上有张快过期的优惠券。你肯定不会介意的吧。我可以继续了吗，Akira 王？

lines.en: : Yup. Time to see who you’ve roped into this, I guess.
lines.zh: : 嗯。是时候看看你都把谁拉进来了，我想。

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo27
: We’ll begin the denizens of the first floor — those who sunk the first stakes into your heart when you climbed into the infinite layers of adolescent Heaven.
lines.zh: : 先来介绍一楼的居民——当你爬进青春天堂那无尽的层叠时，是她们先把桩子钉进了你的心里。

lines.en: : And what better place to begin than with she who’s plunged the stakes into her very own body-
lines.zh: : 而从那个把桩子扎进自己身体里的人开始，再合适不过了——

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo28
: Sana Sakakibara!
lines.zh: : Sana Sakakibara！

lines.en: : H...Hi, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 你……你好，Sensei……

lines.en: : Between this and the swimsuit contest, I guess it’s safe to say you’re not trying to hide your perversions from everyone else anymore, huh?
lines.zh: : 从这次和泳装比赛来看，大概可以肯定你已经不打算再对别人隐瞒自己的变态癖好了，是吧？

lines.en: : I also...came to the last one, so...I figure some people here already know...
lines.zh: : 我上次……也来了，所以……我想这里有些人已经知道了……

lines.en: : Yes. It was a year ago today that we learned of Sana’s desire to...hm, I seem to have forgotten. Could you tell King Akira what you told us back then, Sana?
lines.zh: : 是的。就在一年前的今天，我们得知了 Sana 的愿望是……嗯，我好像忘了。Sana，你能把当时告诉我们的话再对 Akira 王说一遍吗？

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo29
: I kind of...have this little fantasy about being...maybe...abused and raped by a group of really bad people?
lines.zh: : 我有点……有这样一个小小的幻想，就是……也许……被一群很坏很坏的人虐待和强奸？

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo30
: So, uhh...feel free to hurt me as much you like tonight...King Akira.
lines.zh: : 所以，呃……今晚请随意伤害我，想多狠都行……Akira 王。

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo27
: An excellent introduction! But can it be dethroned by she who would sit beside the god-king if he were to choose one from this room?
lines.zh: : 多么精彩的开场！但如果神王要从这屋里挑一个人坐在他身边，那个人能否把她挤下王座呢？

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo31
: Ayane Amamiya!
lines.zh: : Ayane Amamiya！

lines.en: : Hooray! I’m so excited to watch the man I love have sex with all of my friends! Including my roommate who I just found out has a rape fetish!
lines.zh: : 好耶！我太兴奋了，可以看着我爱的男人和我所有的朋友做爱！包括我那个刚被发现有着强奸癖的室友！

lines.en: : Today is so good!
lines.zh: : 今天真是太棒了！

lines.en: : Ayane, seeing as this is your first Nodokathon, perhaps you’d like to share an intimate detail with the god-king?
lines.zh: : Ayane，既然这是你第一次参加 Nodokathon，也许你愿意和神王分享一个私密的小细节？

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo32
: And everyone else in the room? Sure. Fuck it. What do you want to know?
lines.zh: : 还要当着屋里其他所有人的面？行啊。去他的。你想知道什么？

lines.en: : Anything you’re willing to share. Nothing ever leaves this building, of course. Perhaps you have a secret encounter or two with the god-king you’d like to share?
lines.zh: : 任何你愿意分享的都行。当然，这里说的任何话都不会传出这栋楼。也许你有一两次和神王的秘密幽会想分享？

lines.en: : Or a million. I’ve lost count of how many times I’ve snuck into his room to have sex with him while someone else was home.
lines.zh: : 或者说一百万次。我都数不清自己趁屋里还有别人的时候，偷偷溜进他房间和他做爱多少次了。

lines.en: : I...did it with him...while the idol girl was home...the other day...but we just stayed in the living room...
lines.zh: : 我……前几天也和他做了……趁那个偶像女孩在家的时候……不过我们只是在客厅里……

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo31
: And now I know Sana is no longer a virgin! Today can’t get any better!
lines.zh: : 现在我可知道了，Sana 已经不是处女了！今天简直好到不能再好了！

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo27
: Did I...not tell you about that yet?...
lines.zh: : 我……还没跟你说过这件事吗？……

lines.en: : Nope! But in my defense, you may have tried and I probably just closed my ears.
lines.zh: : 没有！不过替我自己说句公道话，你可能说过，而我大概只是把耳朵关上了。

lines.en: : Disregarding that excellent opportunity for a segue and moving briskly along, allow me to introduce the third representative of the first floor!
lines.zh: : 跳过这个绝佳的转场机会，我们快速往下走——请允许我介绍一楼的第三位代表！

lines.en: : Here for her first ever Nodokathon, the first ever legitimate buyer of NodoKorp’s very own quadrildo...
lines.zh: : 首次参加 Nodokathon 的她，也是 NodoKorp 自家出品的四头假阳具的第一位正经买家……

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo33
: Miku Maruyama!
lines.zh: : Miku Maruyama！

lines.en: : I am here to suck a giant wiener and redeem myself for the trivia contest!
lines.zh: : 我是来嗦一根巨型大香肠，顺便为知识问答比赛一雪前耻的！

lines.en: : Now, now — let’s not get ahead of ourselves. Your contest hasn’t been revealed yet.
lines.zh: : 好了好了——别急。你的比赛项目还没公布呢。

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo34
: Okay. But I ain’t breakin’ my vagina again, so y’all better not put me in any kinda insertion contest.
lines.zh: : 行。但我可不想再把我的下面弄裂一次，所以你们最好别把我塞进什么插入类的比赛。

lines.en: : So that...actually happened?
lines.zh: : 那件事……是真的发生过？

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo35
: Sensei stuck it in me and I thought I was gonna die. Blood everywhere. Painkillers barely helped. Excited to finally be able to talk about it with people.
lines.zh: : Sensei 把它插进来的时候，我以为自己要死了。到处都是血。止痛药几乎都没用。终于能跟人聊这件事了，我还挺激动的。

lines.en: : Yeah, well I’m not. That was traumatic for me too.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我可一点都不激动。那对我来说也是创伤。

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo36
: Yeah, but it probably felt better at least. The guys in the pornos I’ve been watchin’ are always goin’ on and on about how good bein’ tight feels.
lines.zh: : 是啊，但至少你大概爽到了吧。我最近看的那些片里的男的，总是一个劲儿地说夹得紧有多爽。

lines.en: : Surprised you didn’t bust a load inside of me as soon as you got the head in. Was Sana like that too?
lines.zh: : 真没想到你龟头刚进去没射在里面。Sana 也是那样的吗？

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo35
: Did you bleed like crazy, Sana? How hard was it to get Sensei’s thing in? You’re smaller than me, so I imagine you- wow. You look really angry all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : Sana，你当时也流了很多血吗？Sensei 那东西插进去有多费劲？你比我小，所以我猜你应该——哇哦。你突然看起来好生气啊。

lines.en: : {i}Nope. Not angry.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}没有。没生气。{/i}

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo27
: That’s it for the first floor then?
lines.zh: : 一楼的就这些了？

lines.en: : That is correct, King Akira. Which means it’s time for Miku to take her place in the line of offerings so we can introduce the first sacrifice from the second floor.
lines.zh: : 没错，Akira 王。也就是说，是时候让 Miku 站进祭品的行列了，这样我们就可以介绍二楼的第一位祭品。

lines.en: : Returning for her second Nodokathon is perhaps the most {i}eager{/i} contestant of all — and one who’s wasted no time today pestering others to touch her.
lines.zh: : 第二次参加 Nodokathon 的她，大概是所有人里最{i}积极{/i}的一位——而且她今天一刻也没浪费，一直在缠着别人摸她。

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo37
: Kirin Kanda!
lines.zh: : Kirin Kanda！

lines.en: : Hi-hi! I can’t tell if I’m more excited for Sensei to be here this time or Miku. Either way, I am horny as fuck and ready to go!
lines.zh: : 嗨——嗨！我都分不清这次是 Sensei 在场更让我兴奋，还是 Miku 在场更让我兴奋。不管怎样，我都他妈的欲火焚身，随时可以开干了！

lines.en: : You contacted me nearly every week for over half a year about another Nodokathon, Kirin. But that all stopped after Christmas. Why is that?
lines.zh: : Kirin，你有大半年时间几乎每周都来问我什么时候再办 Nodokathon。但圣诞节之后就全停了。这是为什么？

lines.en: : Hahah! You’re probably just misremembering. I’ve still been asking about it. There’s definitely nothing that happened on Christmas that would have made me stop.
lines.zh: : 哈哈！你大概是记错了。我一直都在问啊。圣诞节绝对没发生任何会让我停下来的事。

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo38
: Unless Sensei thinks it’s cute that I would have stopped and remembers something about Christmas that I don’t. Hahah! Does he?
lines.zh: : 除非 Sensei 觉得“我居然会停下来”这件事很可爱，并且记得一些我记不得的圣诞节的事。哈哈！他记得吗？

lines.en: : I do remember what I said to you on Christmas, Kirin. Yes.
lines.zh: : 我记得圣诞节那天我对你说过的话，Kirin。是的。

lines.en: : Okay, but is it cute or embarrassing that I stopped asking Nodoka about the thing after that?
lines.zh: : 好吧，但那之后我不再问 Nodoka 那件事了，这算是可爱还是丢人？

lines.en: : It’s very cute and I wish you wouldn’t force yourself to act promiscuous as a means of making me want to fuck you.
lines.zh: : 非常可爱。我真希望你别再强迫自己装出一副浪荡样，好让我想要操你。

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo39
: Got it! I’m gonna go stand over there now.
lines.zh: : 明白！那我现在就去那边站着了。

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo27
: The next resident of the second floor is {i}also{/i} a returning contestant — fittingly wet after a swim back from the depths that guard Tír na nÓg...
lines.zh: : 二楼的下一位居民{i}同样{/i}是一位回归的参赛者——刚从守卫 Tír na nÓg 的深渊游回来，湿得分外应景……

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo40
: Molly MacCormack!
lines.zh: : Molly MacCormack！

lines.en: : Ah! I can feel it! The mana! Coursing through my body and begging to be set-
lines.zh: : 啊！我能感觉到！魔力！正在我体内奔涌，乞求着被释放出——

lines.en: : Molly, is it true that you’re the only girl in this entire room that {i}hasn’t{/i} had penetrative sex with King Akira yet?
lines.zh: : Molly，据说你是这整个房间里唯一{i}还没{/i}和 Akira 王做过插入式性交的女孩，是真的吗？

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo41
: Uhh! Um...
scene prenodokathontwo42
: ...maybe?
lines.zh: : ……也许吧？

lines.en: : Do you not remember?
lines.zh: : 你不记得了吗？

lines.en: : It’s..somewhat complicated. But for the sake of the Supreme Overlord, I will simply just...say no. I have not...been..p...penetrated...by him.
lines.zh: : 这……有点复杂。但看在至高无上领主的分上，我就……直接说没有吧。我还没有……被他……插……插入过。

lines.en: : And would you {i}like{/i} to be? In front of all of your friends?
lines.zh: : 那你{i}想要{/i}吗？当着你所有朋友的面？

lines.en: : Perhaps we should mark the opening of {i}all{/i} future Nodokathons with a ritualistic deflowering in front of-
lines.zh: : 也许我们该给今后{i}每一届{/i} Nodokathon 的开幕，都安排一场仪式性的破处，就当着——

lines.en: : Just get to the last contestant, Nodoka. I’m not going to fuck Molly for the first time in front of everyone.
lines.zh: : 直接介绍最后一位参赛者吧，Nodoka。我不会当着所有人的面夺走 Molly 的第一次。

lines.en: : You will if it’s part of the script.
lines.zh: : 如果这是剧本的一部分，你就会。

lines.en: : Fortunately for you, though — this is the part of the script where things become...interesting.
lines.zh: : 不过对你来说幸运的是——剧本到了这一段，事情会变得……有意思起来。

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo43
: Are they not already? Because I have to admit, this is officially the largest group of girls I have ever walked into a potential sex act with.
lines.zh: : 现在还不够有意思吗？因为我得承认，这正式成为我有史以来走进一场潜在性行为时，面对的人数最多的一群女孩。

lines.en: : Potentiality is no longer the correct term, Akira. We’ve reached the point of no return.
lines.zh: : “潜在”这个词已经不准确了，Akira。我们已经到了无法回头的地步。

lines.en: : From this moment forward, it is {i}our{/i} duty to help you ascend to true godhood.
lines.zh: : 从此刻起，助你飞升为真神，是{i}我们{/i}的职责。

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo44
: And I can think of no one better to assist with this-
lines.zh: : 而我想不出还有谁比她更适合协助这件事——

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo45
: Than your very own daughter — Ami Arakawa!
lines.zh: : 那就是你亲生的女儿——Ami Arakawa！

lines.en: : Surprise!
lines.zh: : 惊喜吧！

lines.en: : Ami?! What are you-
lines.zh: : Ami？！你在——

lines.en: : Oh come on, Dad! You heard Nodoka, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 拜托，爸爸！你听到 Nodoka 说的话了嘛？

lines.en: : You’ve passed the point of no return! Nobody here {i}really{/i} cares if you cum inside your daughter every day! Which you do! And I love it every time!
lines.zh: : 你已经过了无法回头的那条线了！这里没人{i}在乎{/i}你每天射在你女儿里面！反正你确实天天都射！而我每一次都喜欢得要命！

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo46
: Ami here will be competing on behalf of the second floor today against her good friend Ayane, who currently looks as if she’s seen a ghost.
lines.zh: : Ami 今天将代表二楼出战，对手是她的好朋友 Ayane——后者现在的表情，就像是见了鬼一样。

lines.en: : Are you fucking kidding me?...In front of everyone?...
lines.zh: : 你他妈在逗我吗？……当着所有人的面？……

lines.zh: : 什么，你们可以我不行？这公平吗？

: We’re not related to him!
lines.zh: : 我们可跟他没有血缘关系！

lines.en: : Is it just me or does being related to him give me {i}more{/i} of a reason to have sex with him in front of a group?
lines.zh: : 是我一个人的错觉吗，还是说跟他有血缘关系，反而给了我{i}更{/i}多在一群人面前和他做爱的理由？

lines.en: : It’s just you, Ami! It is {i}just{/i} you!
lines.zh: : 就是你的错觉，Ami！就是{i}只有{/i}你！

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo48
: See that shirt, Sana? {i}I{/i} sold her that. Your girl Miku’s risin’ up the charts. One down, six million to go. Then, everyone on earth will have one.
lines.zh: : Sana，看见那件 T 恤了吗？{i}我{/i}卖给她的。你家 Miku 正在排行榜上一路上升。卖掉一件，还差六百万件。到那时候，地球上的每个人都会有一件。

lines.en: scene prenodokathontwo49
